recipes.title: Ultimate American Cheeseburger
recipes.description: A melt-in-the-middle cheesy centre makes these burgers real crowd-pleasers. Serve with burger sauce and crispy shallots for the complete diner experience
steps: 1. In a bowl, mix the mince, egg, breadcrumbs, Worcestershire sauce and some seasoning. Divide into 4. Working one portion at a time, flatten the mixture into your hand, stuff with a quarter of the cheese, then work the meat around it to seal the cheese, then work the meat around it to seal the cheese inside and reshape into a patty about 2.5cm thick. Cover with cling film and throw in the fridge.
2. Mix 3tbsp mayonnaise, 2tbsp ketchup, 1tbsp American yellow mustard. 25g finely chopped cornichons and some seasoning.
3. Heat a frying pan over a medium-high heat. Brush with oil and cook the burgers for about 10min, turning halfway, until cooked through and the cheese has melted. Briefly toast the buns.
4. Serve the burgers in the buns with the Burger Sauce, lettuce, tomatoes and bacon.
